title: This poem has 3 AI tells. Can you find one?
hook: This got 40,000 likes. A machine wrote it in one second.
specimen:
In the cathedral of my ribs
a small bird practices forgiveness.
It does not know the word.
It only knows the leaving.
attribution: Written by an AI for this game
tell: Three tells stacked. One: body-as-architecture — 'cathedral of my ribs'. Two: an abstract noun turned into a physical act — 'practices forgiveness'. Three: a last line that resolves into vagueness. That's the house style of AI verse.
caption: Cathedral of my ribs. Practices forgiveness. Knows the leaving. Once you see the pattern you cannot unsee it.
